translations.literal: But when gentlemen are frustrated and not employed, and public judgment is blocked and cannot be extended, then worry and anger knot in the heart and sleep and food are both abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: But when gentlemen are frustrated and not employed, and public judgment is blocked, then worry knots in the heart and sleep and food are both abandoned.

sentences.zh: 臣聞扶植宗社在君子，扶植君子在公論。

translations.literal: Your servant hears that to support the altars of state lies in gentlemen, and to support gentlemen lies in public judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant hears that to support the altars of state lies in gentlemen, and to support gentlemen lies in public judgment.

sentences.zh: 陛下在位幾三十年，端平間公正萃朝，忠讜接武，天下翕然曰：「此小元祐也。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty has been on the throne nearly thirty years; in the Duanping period the upright gathered at court and loyal remonstrance followed in succession; all under heaven said with one voice: "This is a minor Yuanyou."
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has been on the throne nearly thirty years; in the Duanping period the upright gathered at court and loyal remonstrance followed in succession; all under heaven said with one voice: "This is a minor Yuanyou."

sentences.zh: 淳祐初，大奸屏跡，善類在位，天下又翕然曰：「此又一端平也。」

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chunyou great villains were removed and good men held office; all under heaven again said with one voice: "This is another Duanping."
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chunyou great villains were removed and good men held office; all under heaven again said with one voice: "This is another Duanping."

sentences.zh: 奈何年來培養保護之初心，不能不爲之轉移。

translations.literal: How can the original intent of nurturing and protecting not fail to be shifted?
translations.idiomatic: How can the original intent of nurturing and protecting fail to be shifted?

sentences.zh: 祖宗建置台諫，本以伸君子而折小人，昌公論而杜私說。

translations.literal: The ancestors established the censorate and remonstrance bureaus originally to extend gentlemen and break petty men, to make public judgment flourish and private opinions fail.
translations.idiomatic: The ancestors established the censorate and remonstrance bureaus originally to extend gentlemen and break petty men, to make public judgment flourish and private opinions fail.

sentences.zh: 乃今老饕自肆，奸種相仍，以諂諛承風旨，以傾險設機阱，以淟涊盜官爵。

translations.literal: Yet today old gluttons act as they please, wicked seeds follow one another, using flattery to carry out secret intent, using treachery to set snares, using baseness to steal office and rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yet today old gluttons act as they please, wicked seeds follow one another, using flattery to carry out secret intent, using treachery to set snares, using baseness to steal office and rank.

sentences.zh: 陛下非不識拔群賢，彼則忍于空君子之党；

translations.literal: Your Majesty is not without recognizing and elevating the host of worthies—yet they bear to empty the party of gentlemen;
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is not without recognizing and elevating the host of worthies—yet they bear to empty the party of gentlemen;

sentences.zh: 陛下非不容受直言，彼則勇於倒公議之戈。

translations.literal: Your Majesty is not without tolerating forthright speech—yet they boldly overturn the spear of public judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is not without tolerating forthright speech—yet they boldly overturn the spear of public judgment.

sentences.zh: 不知陛下何負此輩，而彼乃負陛下至此耶？

translations.literal: Does Your Majesty not know what you have done for this crowd, that they have failed Your Majesty to this degree?
translations.idiomatic: What has Your Majesty done for this crowd, that they have failed you to this degree?

sentences.zh: 當陛下詔起匯髦之秋，而公許起自家食，正君子覘之，以爲進退之機。

translations.literal: When Your Majesty's edict summoned the gathered worthies, Gongxu rose from private life; upright gentlemen watched it as the turning point of advance and retreat.
translations.idiomatic: When Your Majesty's edict summoned the gathered worthies, Gongxu rose from private life; upright gentlemen watched it as the turning point of advance and retreat.

sentences.zh: 乃今坐席未溫，彈章已上，一公許去，若未害也，臣恐草野諸賢，見幾深遁，而君子之脈自此絕矣。

translations.literal: Yet now he has not warmed his seat before impeachment memorials arrive; one Gongxu departs—if it seems no harm, your servant fears that worthies in the wild, seeing the first sign, will flee deep, and the artery of gentlemen will from this be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Yet now he has not warmed his seat before impeachment memorials arrive; one Gongxu departs—if it seems no harm, your servant fears that worthies in the wild, seeing the first sign, will flee deep, and the artery of gentlemen will from this be cut off.

sentences.zh: 比年朋邪記焰，緘默成風，奏事者不過襲陳言、應故事而已。

translations.literal: In recent years factional wickedness blazed; silence became the custom; those who memorialized did no more than repeat stale words and answer old stories.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years factional wickedness blazed; silence became the custom; those who memorialized did no more than repeat stale words and answer old stories.

sentences.zh: 幸而之純兩疏，差強人意。

translations.literal: Fortunately Zhichun's two memorials were somewhat satisfying.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately Zhichun's two memorials were somewhat satisfying.

sentences.zh: 乃今軟媚者全身，鯁直者去國，一之純去，若未害也，臣恐道路以目，欲言輒沮，而公論之脈自此絕矣。

translations.literal: Yet now the soft and fawning preserve themselves whole while the lodged and upright leave the state; one Zhichun departs—if it seems no harm, your servant fears that on the roads men cover their eyes and those who wish to speak are stopped, and the artery of public judgment will from this be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Yet now the soft and fawning preserve themselves whole while the lodged and upright leave the state; one Zhichun departs—if it seems no harm, your servant fears that on the roads men cover their eyes and those who wish to speak are stopped, and the artery of public judgment will from this be cut off.

sentences.zh: 況今天下可言之事不爲少，可攻之惡不爲不多。

translations.literal: Moreover, matters in the realm today that can be spoken of are not few; evils that can be attacked are not few.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, matters in the realm today that can be spoken of are not few; evils that can be attacked are not few.

sentences.zh: 術窮桑、孔，浸有逼上之嫌；

translations.literal: Their arts exhaust those of Sang and Kong and gradually have the suspicion of pressing upon the throne;
translations.idiomatic: Their arts exhaust those of Sang and Kong and gradually have the suspicion of pressing upon the throne;

sentences.zh: 勢挾金、張，濫處牧民之職。

translations.literal: their power embraces the Jin and Zhang clans and they indiscriminately hold posts of shepherding the people.
translations.idiomatic: their power embraces the Jin and Zhang clans and they indiscriminately hold posts of shepherding the people.

sentences.zh: 以乳臭騃子而躐登從橐，以光範私人而累典輔藩。

translations.literal: By suckling infants and fools they leap to attendants' satchels; by private persons of the Guangfan Gate they repeatedly hold frontier prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: By suckling infants and fools they leap to attendants' satchels; by private persons of the Guangfan Gate they repeatedly hold frontier prefectures.

sentences.zh: 錢神通靈於旁蹊，公器反類於互市。

translations.literal: Money's spirit works through side paths; public vessels resemble a mutual market.
translations.idiomatic: Money's spirit works through side paths; public vessels resemble a mutual market.

sentences.zh: 天下皆知之，豈陛下獨不知之。

translations.literal: All under heaven know it—does Your Majesty alone not know it?
translations.idiomatic: All under heaven know it—does Your Majesty alone not know it?

sentences.zh: 正惟爲陛下紀綱者知爲身謀，不爲陛下謀。

translations.literal: It is precisely because those who regulate Your Majesty's discipline know to scheme for themselves and not for Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: It is precisely because those who regulate Your Majesty's discipline know to scheme for themselves and not for Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 陛下明燭事幾，詎可墮此輩蒙蔽術中，何忍以祖宗三百年風憲之司，而壞於一二小人之手耶？

translations.literal: Your Majesty clearly illuminates affairs—how can you fall into these men's net of deception? How can you bear to let the wind and discipline office of three hundred years of the ancestors be ruined in the hands of one or two petty men?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty clearly illuminates affairs—how can you fall into these men's net of deception? How can you bear to let the wind and discipline office of three hundred years of the ancestors be ruined in the hands of one or two petty men?

sentences.zh: 臣汝騰，陛下之劉向也，則以忠鯁斥；

translations.literal: Your servant Zhao Ruteng is Your Majesty's Liu Xiang—yet for loyal lodged speech he was expelled;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant Zhao Ruteng is Your Majesty's Liu Xiang—yet for loyal lodged speech he was expelled;

sentences.zh: 臣子才、臣棟、臣伯玉，陛下之汲黯也，則以切直罷。

translations.literal: your servants Zicai, Dong, and Boyu are Your Majesty's Ji An—yet for cutting straightness they were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: your servants Zicai, Dong, and Boyu are Your Majesty's Ji An—yet for cutting straightness they were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 遂使淳祐諸君子日消月磨，至今幾爲之一空。

translations.literal: Thus the gentlemen of Chunyou daily wane month by month, until today they are nearly all emptied.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the gentlemen of Chunyou daily wane month by month, until today they are nearly all emptied.

sentences.zh: 彼誠何心哉？

translations.literal: What heart do they truly have?
translations.idiomatic: What heart do they truly have?

sentences.zh: 高宗紹興二十年之詔，有謂「台諫風憲之地，年來用人非據，與大臣爲友党，濟其喜怒，甚非耳目之寄。」

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong's edict of the twentieth year of Shaoxing said: "The censorate and remonstrance bureaus are places of wind and discipline; in recent years appointments have been unfit, forming factions with great ministers to aid their likes and dislikes—this greatly fails the charge of being eyes and ears."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong's edict of the twentieth year of Shaoxing said: "The censorate and remonstrance bureaus are places of wind and discipline; in recent years appointments have been unfit, forming factions with great ministers to aid their likes and dislikes—this greatly fails the charge of being eyes and ears."

sentences.zh: 臣竊觀近事，不獨台諫爲大臣友党，內簡相傳，風旨相諭，且甘爲鷹犬而聽其指嗾焉。

translations.literal: Your servant has observed recent affairs: not only do the censorate and remonstrance bureaus become factions with great ministers—inner drafts are passed along, secret intent is conveyed, and they willingly become hawks and dogs heeding their beckoning.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has observed recent affairs: not only do the censorate and remonstrance bureaus become factions with great ministers—inner drafts are passed along, secret intent is conveyed, and they willingly become hawks and dogs heeding their beckoning.

sentences.zh: 宰相所不樂者，外若示以優容，而陰實頤指台諫以去之；

translations.literal: What the chief councilor dislikes, outwardly he seems to show generous tolerance, but inwardly he actually signals the censorate and remonstrance bureaus to remove them;
translations.idiomatic: What the chief councilor dislikes, outwardly he seems to show generous tolerance, but inwardly he actually signals the censorate and remonstrance bureaus to remove them;

sentences.zh: 台諫所彈擊者，外若不相爲謀，而陰實奉承宰相以行之。

translations.literal: whom the censorate and remonstrance bureaus attack, outwardly they seem not to conspire, but inwardly they actually carry out the chief councilor's will.
translations.idiomatic: whom the censorate and remonstrance bureaus attack, outwardly they seem not to conspire, but inwardly they actually carry out the chief councilor's will.

sentences.zh: 方公許之召也，天下皆知獨斷於宸衷，及公許之來也，天下亦知嘗得罪于時宰，豈料陛下之恩終不足恃，宰相之嗔竟不可逃耶？

translations.literal: When Gongxu was summoned, all under heaven knew the decision rested alone in Your Majesty's heart; when Gongxu came, all under heaven also knew he had once offended the chief councilor of the time—who expected that Your Majesty's favor in the end would not suffice to rely upon, and the chief councilor's anger in the end could not be escaped?
translations.idiomatic: When Gongxu was summoned, all under heaven knew the decision rested alone in Your Majesty's heart; when Gongxu came, all under heaven also knew he had once offended the chief councilor of the time—who expected that Your Majesty's favor in the end would not suffice to rely upon, and the chief councilor's anger in the end could not be escaped?

sentences.zh: 陛下萬機之暇，試以公許、之純與垓、滎等熟思而靜評之，其言論孰正孰邪，孰忠孰佞，雖中智以下之主，猶知判別是非，況以陛下明聖而顧不察此？

translations.literal: In Your Majesty's leisure from the myriad tasks, try to think over Gongxu and Zhichun versus Gai and Ying with calm judgment—which speeches are upright and which crooked, which loyal and which fawning? Even a ruler of middling intelligence would know to distinguish right and wrong; how much more Your Majesty's brilliance, yet not to examine this?
translations.idiomatic: In Your Majesty's leisure from the myriad tasks, try to think over Gongxu and Zhichun versus Gai and Ying with calm judgment—which speeches are upright and which crooked, which loyal and which fawning? Even a ruler of middling intelligence would know to distinguish right and wrong; how much more Your Majesty's brilliance, yet not to examine this?

sentences.zh: 近見公許奏疏，嘗告陛下揭至公以示天下；

translations.literal: Recently seeing Gongxu's memorial, he once told Your Majesty to display utmost impartiality to show all under heaven;
translations.idiomatic: Recently seeing Gongxu's memorial, he once told Your Majesty to display utmost impartiality to show all under heaven;

sentences.zh: 垓則以秘密之說惑上聽，公許嘗告陛下以寵賂日章，官邪無警，欲塞幸門，絕曲徑；

translations.literal: Gai then used secret talk to delude what the Emperor heard; Gongxu once told Your Majesty that favor and bribes daily multiply and official wickedness goes unheeded, wishing to block the path of favor and cut off crooked byways;
translations.idiomatic: Gai then used secret talk to delude what the Emperor heard; Gongxu once told Your Majesty that favor and bribes daily multiply and official wickedness goes unheeded, wishing to block the path of favor and cut off crooked byways;

sentences.zh: 垓則縱俠客以兜攬關節，持闊扁以脅取舉狀，開賂門以簸弄按章。

translations.literal: Gai then let roaming knights round up frontier connections, held broad placards to extort nomination documents, and opened the gate of bribes to manipulate impeachment memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Gai then let roaming knights round up frontier connections, held broad placards to extort nomination documents, and opened the gate of bribes to manipulate impeachment memorials.

sentences.zh: 至若之純之告陛下，力伸邪正之辯，明斥媚相之非，謇謇諤諤，流出肺肝；

translations.literal: As for what Zhichun told Your Majesty, he vigorously extended the debate of evil and upright, clearly condemned the error of fawning at the councilor, lodged and forthright, pouring from lung and liver;
translations.idiomatic: As for what Zhichun told Your Majesty, he vigorously extended the debate of evil and upright, clearly condemned the error of fawning at the councilor, lodged and forthright, pouring from lung and liver;

sentences.zh: 滎身居言責，聞其風聲，自當愧死，尚敢妄肆萋菲，略無人心乎？

translations.literal: Ying holds the charge of speech—hearing such a wind he ought to die of shame; how dare he still wildly spread calumny, slightly without human heart?
translations.idiomatic: Ying holds the charge of speech—hearing such a wind he ought to die of shame; how dare he still wildly spread calumny, slightly without human heart?

sentences.zh: 且陛下擢用台諫，若臣磊卿、臣咨夔、臣應起、臣漢弼、臣凱、臣燧，光明俊偉，卓爲天下稱首，然甫入而遽遷，或一鳴而輒斥，獨垓、滎輩貪饕頑忍，久汙要津，根據而不拔，劉向所謂「用賢轉石，去佞拔山」者，乃今見之，可不畏哉？

translations.literal: Moreover when Your Majesty promoted and used the censorate and remonstrance bureaus, such men as Leiqing, Ziqing, Yingqi, Hanbi, Kai, and Sui were bright and handsome, outstanding as the first under heaven—yet on entering they were hastily transferred, or with one cry were expelled; only Gai, Ying, and their crowd are greedy, obstinate, and long foul the vital ford, rooted and not pulled up—what Liu Xiang called "using the worthy turns stone, removing the fawning pulls mountain"—is seen today; can one not fear it?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover when Your Majesty promoted and used the censorate and remonstrance bureaus, such men as Leiqing, Ziqing, Yingqi, Hanbi, Kai, and Sui were bright and handsome, outstanding as the first under heaven—yet on entering they were hastily transferred, or with one cry were expelled; only Gai, Ying, and their crowd are greedy, obstinate, and long foul the vital ford, rooted and not pulled up—what Liu Xiang called "using the worthy turns stone, removing the fawning pulls mountain"—is seen today; can one not fear it?

sentences.zh: 矧今國嗣未正，事會方殷，民生膏血，朘削殆盡，所賴以祈天命，系人心，惟君子與公論一脈耳。

translations.literal: Moreover today the imperial heir is not yet settled and affairs press; the people's fat and blood are nearly all pared away; what relies on to pray to heaven's mandate and bind men's hearts is only the one artery of gentlemen and public judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover today the imperial heir is not yet settled and affairs press; the people's fat and blood are nearly all pared away; what relies on to pray to heaven's mandate and bind men's hearts is only the one artery of gentlemen and public judgment.

sentences.zh: 小人以不恤之心，爲無忌憚之事，其意不過欲爵位日穹，權勢日盛，以富貴遣子孫耳，豈暇爲國家計哉。

translations.literal: Petty men with hearts that do not pity do reckless things without dread; their intent is only that rank daily mount and power daily flourish, to send wealth and honor to sons and grandsons—how can they spare thought for the state?
translations.idiomatic: Petty men with hearts that do not pity do reckless things without dread; their intent is only that rank daily mount and power daily flourish, to send wealth and honor to sons and grandsons—how can they spare thought for the state?

sentences.zh: 自昔天下之患，莫大於舉朝無公論，空國無君子。

translations.literal: From of old the calamity of all under heaven has been greatest when the whole court has no public judgment and the state is empty of gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: From of old the calamity of all under heaven has been greatest when the whole court has no public judgment and the state is empty of gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 我朝本無大失德於天下，而乃有宣、靖之禍，夫豈無其故哉？

translations.literal: Our dynasty originally had no great loss of virtue toward all under heaven—yet there were the disasters of Xuanhe and Jingkang; was there not a reason?
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty originally had no great loss of virtue toward all under heaven—yet there were the disasters of Xuanhe and Jingkang; was there not a reason?

sentences.zh: 始則邪正交攻，更出迭入，中則朋邪翼偽，陰陷潛詆，終則倒置是非，變亂黑白，不至於黨禍不止。

translations.literal: At first evil and upright attacked each other, going out and entering in turn; in the middle factional wickedness winged falsity, secretly trapping and slandering; in the end they inverted right and wrong and confused black and white, not stopping until the faction disaster ended.
translations.idiomatic: At first evil and upright attacked each other, going out and entering in turn; in the middle factional wickedness winged falsity, secretly trapping and slandering; in the end they inverted right and wrong and confused black and white, not stopping until the faction disaster ended.

sentences.zh: 向使劉安世、陳瓘諸賢尚無恙，楊畏、張商英、周秩輩不久據台綱，其禍豈至此烈。

translations.literal: If gentlemen such as Liu Anshi and Chen Guan had still been unharmed and men like Yang Wei, Zhang Shangying, and Zhou Zhi had not long held censorate authority, would the calamity have reached this fierceness?
translations.idiomatic: If gentlemen such as Liu Anshi and Chen Guan had still been unharmed and men like Yang Wei, Zhang Shangying, and Zhou Zhi had not long held censorate authority, would the calamity have reached this fierceness?

sentences.zh: 古語云：「前車覆，後車戒。」

translations.literal: The old saying says: "The front cart overturns; the rear cart takes warning."
translations.idiomatic: The old saying says: "The front cart overturns; the rear cart takes warning."

sentences.zh: 今朝廷善類無幾，心懷奸險者，則以文藻飾佞舌；

translations.literal: Today there are few good sorts at court; those whose hearts harbor treachery use literary ornament to decorate fawning tongues;
translations.idiomatic: Today there are few good sorts at court; those whose hearts harbor treachery use literary ornament to decorate fawning tongues;

sentences.zh: 志在依違者，則以首鼠持圓機。

translations.literal: those whose intent is to waver use the shrew-mouse to hold the round mechanism.
translations.idiomatic: those whose intent is to waver use the shrew-mouse to hold the round mechanism.

sentences.zh: 宗社大計，孰肯明目張膽爲陛下伸一喙者，則其勢必終於空國無君子，舉朝無公論。

translations.literal: On the great plan of the altars of state, who is willing to open eyes and mouth to speak one word for Your Majesty? Then the situation must end in an empty state without gentlemen and a court without public judgment.
translations.idiomatic: On the great plan of the altars of state, who is willing to open eyes and mouth to speak one word for Your Majesty? Then the situation must end in an empty state without gentlemen and a court without public judgment.

sentences.zh: 無君子，無公論，脫有緩急，彼一二憸人者，陛下獨可倚仗之乎？

translations.literal: Without gentlemen, without public judgment—if urgency arises, can Your Majesty alone rely on those one or two crafty men?
translations.idiomatic: Without gentlemen, without public judgment—if urgency arises, can Your Majesty alone rely on those one or two crafty men?

sentences.zh: 若垓之罪，又浮於滎，雖兩觀之誅，四裔之投，猶爲輕典，陛下留之一日，則長一日之禍，異時雖借尚方劍以礪其首，尚何救于國事之萬一哉？

translations.literal: As for Gai's crime, it floats above Ying's; though execution at the two observances and banishment to the four wilds would still be a light code—Your Majesty keeps him one day and lengthens one day's calamity; in another time though you borrow the imperial sword to sharpen his head, how will it save the myriad one of state affairs?
translations.idiomatic: As for Gai's crime, it floats above Ying's; though execution at the two observances and banishment to the four wilds would still be a light code—Your Majesty keeps him one day and lengthens one day's calamity; in another time though you borrow the imperial sword to sharpen his head, how will it save the myriad one of state affairs?

sentences.zh: 又曰：「自昔大奸巨孽，投閒散地，惟覘朝廷意向，以圖進用之機。

translations.literal: It also said: "From of old great villains and great criminals, cast into leisure and scattered places, only watch the court's intent to plot the opening for advancement and employment.
translations.idiomatic: It also said: "From of old great villains and great criminals, cast into leisure and scattered places, only watch the court's intent to plot the opening for advancement and employment.

sentences.zh: 元祐間，章惇、呂惠卿皆在貶所。

translations.literal: In the Yuanyou period, Zhang Dun and Lü Huiqing were both in places of demotion.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanyou period, Zhang Dun and Lü Huiqing were both in places of demotion.

sentences.zh: 自呂大防用楊畏爲御史，初意不過信用私人，牢護局面，不知小人得志，搖唇鼓吻，一時正人旋被斥逐，繼而章惇復柄用，雖大防亦不能安其身於朝廷之上。

translations.literal: From when Lü Dagfang employed Yang Wei as investigating censor, the original intent was only to employ private men and firmly protect the situation—not knowing that when petty men obtain their aim, they wag lips and beat drums and upright men of the time were soon expelled; afterward Zhang Dun again held the handle, and even Dagfang could not keep himself secure above the court.
translations.idiomatic: From when Lü Dagfang employed Yang Wei as investigating censor, the original intent was only to employ private men and firmly protect the situation—not knowing that when petty men obtain their aim, they wag lips and beat drums and upright men of the time were soon expelled; afterward Zhang Dun again held the handle, and even Dagfang could not keep himself secure above the court.

sentences.zh: 今右轄久虛，奸臣垂涎有日矣。

translations.literal: Today the right Secretariat has long been vacant; crafty ministers have drooled for days.
translations.idiomatic: Today the right Secretariat has long been vacant; crafty ministers have drooled for days.

sentences.zh: 聞之道路，饋遺不止於鞭靴，脈絡潛通於禁近，正陛下明察事機之時。

translations.literal: Heard on the roads: gifts do not stop at whips and boots; arteries secretly connect to the forbidden proximity—this is the time for Your Majesty's clear examination of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Heard on the roads: gifts do not stop at whips and boots; arteries secretly connect to the forbidden proximity—this is the time for Your Majesty's clear examination of affairs.

sentences.zh: 若公論不明，正人引去，則遲回輾轉，鈞衡重寄，必歸於章惇等乃止。

translations.literal: If public judgment is not clear and upright men withdraw, then hesitating and turning, the weighty commission of the balance will necessarily return to Zhang Dun and the like before it stops.
translations.idiomatic: If public judgment is not clear and upright men withdraw, then hesitating and turning, the weighty commission of the balance will necessarily return to Zhang Dun and the like before it stops.

sentences.zh: 今日之天下，乃祖宗艱難積累之天下，豈堪此輩再壞耶？」

translations.literal: Today's all under heaven is the all under heaven the ancestors accumulated through hardship—how can it bear to be ruined again by this crowd?"
translations.idiomatic: Today's all under heaven is the all under heaven the ancestors accumulated through hardship—how can it bear to be ruined again by this crowd?"

sentences.zh: 又諫遊幸疏曰：

translations.literal: He also remonstrated with a memorial on imperial tours, saying:
translations.idiomatic: He also remonstrated with a memorial on imperial tours, saying:

sentences.zh: 天下有道，人主以憂勤而忘逸樂；

translations.literal: When all under heaven has the Way, the ruler through worry and diligence forgets ease and pleasure;
translations.idiomatic: When all under heaven has the Way, the ruler through worry and diligence forgets ease and pleasure;

sentences.zh: 天下無道，人主以逸樂而忘憂勤。

translations.literal: when all under heaven lacks the Way, the ruler through ease and pleasure forgets worry and diligence.
translations.idiomatic: when all under heaven lacks the Way, the ruler through ease and pleasure forgets worry and diligence.

sentences.zh: 自昔國家乂安，四夷賓服，享國日久，侈心漸生，若漢武帝之單于震懾，而有千門萬戶之觀，唐明皇之北邊無事，而有驪山溫泉之幸。

translations.literal: From of old when states were at peace and the four barbarians submitted, enjoying the state long, extravagant hearts gradually arose—such as Emperor Wu of Han when the Xiongnu were awed and he had the view of a thousand gates and ten thousand households, or Emperor Mingzong of Tang when the northern border was without affair and there was the fortune of Mount Li's hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: From of old when states were at peace and the four barbarians submitted, enjoying the state long, extravagant hearts gradually arose—such as Emperor Wu of Han when the Xiongnu were awed and he had the view of a thousand gates and ten thousand households, or Emperor Mingzong of Tang when the northern border was without affair and there was the fortune of Mount Li's hot springs.

sentences.zh: 至於隋之煬帝，陳之後主，危亡日迫，遊觀無度，不足效也。

translations.literal: As for Emperor Yang of Sui and the Last Emperor of Chen, peril and extinction pressed daily and tours and views were without measure—not worth imitating.
translations.idiomatic: As for Emperor Yang of Sui and the Last Emperor of Chen, peril and extinction pressed daily and tours and views were without measure—not worth imitating.

sentences.zh: 堯、舜、禹、湯、文、武之競業祗懼，終始憂勤，《無逸》言：「遊畋則不敢，日昃則不暇食。

translations.literal: Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu competed in industry and held dread; from beginning to end they were worried and diligent; the "No Dissipation" chapter says: "In hunting they did not dare; at sundown they had no leisure to eat.
translations.idiomatic: Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu competed in industry and held dread; from beginning to end they were worried and diligent; the "No Dissipation" chapter says: "In hunting they did not dare; at sundown they had no leisure to eat.

sentences.zh: 曷嘗借祈禳之說，以事遊觀之逸。

translations.literal: When did they ever borrow the talk of prayer and sacrifice to serve the ease of tours and views?
translations.idiomatic: When did they ever borrow the talk of prayer and sacrifice to serve the ease of tours and views?

sentences.zh: 比年以來，以幸爲利，以玩爲常，未免有輕視世故、眇忽天下之心。

translations.literal: In recent years, taking favor as profit and play as constant, one cannot avoid having a heart that lightly regards worldly affairs and overlooks all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years, taking favor as profit and play as constant, one cannot avoid having a heart that lightly regards worldly affairs and overlooks all under heaven.

sentences.zh: 單于未嘗震懾，而有武帝多欲之費耗；

translations.literal: The Xiongnu have not been awed, yet there is Emperor Wu's wasteful expenditure of many desires;
translations.idiomatic: The Xiongnu have not been awed, yet there is Emperor Wu's wasteful expenditure of many desires;

sentences.zh: 北邊未嘗無事，而有明皇宴安之鴆毒。

translations.literal: the northern border has not been without affair, yet there is Emperor Mingzong's poison of banquet ease.
translations.idiomatic: the northern border has not been without affair, yet there is Emperor Mingzong's poison of banquet ease.

sentences.zh: 陛下春秋尚少，貽謀垂憲之機，悉在陛下，作而不法，後嗣何觀？

translations.literal: Your Majesty's spring and autumn are still young; the opportunity to leave plans and model statutes lies all in Your Majesty—if you act and do not take law, what will posterity observe?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's spring and autumn are still young; the opportunity to leave plans and model statutes lies all in Your Majesty—if you act and do not take law, what will posterity observe?

sentences.zh: 自十數年間，創龍翔，創集慶，創西太一，而又示之以遊幸，導之以禱祠，蠱之以虛誕不經之說。

translations.literal: Within the last dozen years Longxiang was founded, Jiqing founded, Western Great Unity founded—and moreover tours and views were shown as example, prayer and sacrifice led as guide, and they were bewitched by vain and uncanonical talk.
translations.idiomatic: Within the last dozen years Longxiang was founded, Jiqing founded, Western Great Unity founded—and moreover tours and views were shown as example, prayer and sacrifice led as guide, and they were bewitched by vain and uncanonical talk.

sentences.zh: 孔子曰：「少成若天性，習慣如自然。」

translations.literal: Confucius said: "What is formed young is like nature; habit is like the natural."
translations.idiomatic: Confucius said: "What is formed young is like nature; habit is like the natural."

sentences.zh: 積久慣熟，牢不可破，誰得而正之？

translations.literal: Accumulated long, habit becomes familiar, firmly cannot be broken—who can correct it?
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated long, habit becomes familiar, firmly cannot be broken—who can correct it?

sentences.zh: 且西太一之役，佞者進曰：「太一所臨分野則爲福，近歲自吳移蜀。」

translations.literal: Moreover the work on Western Great Unity: fawning men advanced and said: "Where the Great Unity faces, that circuit is blessed; in recent years it moved from Wu to Shu."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the work on Western Great Unity: fawning men advanced and said: "Where the Great Unity faces, that circuit is blessed; in recent years it moved from Wu to Shu."

sentences.zh: 信如祈禳之說，西北坤維按堵可也。

translations.literal: If one believes the talk of prayer and sacrifice, the northwest kun axis ought to be secure.
translations.idiomatic: If one believes the talk of prayer and sacrifice, the northwest kun axis ought to be secure.

sentences.zh: 今五六十州，安全者不能十數，敗降者相繼，福何在邪？

translations.literal: Today of fifty or sixty prefectures, those secure cannot number ten; defeat and surrender follow in succession—where is the blessing?
translations.idiomatic: Today of fifty or sixty prefectures, those secure cannot number ten; defeat and surrender follow in succession—where is the blessing?

sentences.zh: 武帝祠太一于長安，至晚年以虛耗受禍，而後悔方士之繆。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu sacrificed to the Great Unity at Chang'an; reaching his later years he received calamity from empty waste and regretted the error of the formula masters.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu sacrificed to the Great Unity at Chang'an; reaching his later years he received calamity from empty waste and regretted the error of the formula masters.

sentences.zh: 雖其悔之弗早，猶愈於終不知悔者也。

translations.literal: Though his regret was not early, it is still better than never knowing regret.
translations.idiomatic: Though his regret was not early, it is still better than never knowing regret.

sentences.zh: 大凡人主不能無過，脫有過言過行，宰執、侍從當言之，給舍、台諫當言之，縉紳士大夫當言之，皆所以納君於當道者也。

translations.literal: Generally a ruler cannot be without fault; if there are faulty words or faulty acts, the chief councilors and attendants-in-waiting ought to speak, the drafting secretaries and censorate ought to speak, girdled scholars and great officials ought to speak—all are means to lead the ruler into the right path.
translations.idiomatic: Generally a ruler cannot be without fault; if there are faulty words or faulty acts, the chief councilors and attendants-in-waiting ought to speak, the drafting secretaries and censorate ought to speak, girdled scholars and great officials ought to speak—all are means to lead the ruler into the right path.

sentences.zh: 今陛下未爲不知道，未爲不受人言，宰執以下希寵而不言，與夫言之而不力，皆非所以愛陛下也。

translations.literal: Today Your Majesty is not yet without knowing the Way, not yet without receiving men's words—yet from the chief councilors down they curry favor and do not speak, and those who speak do not exert force; none is what loves Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Today Your Majesty is not yet without knowing the Way, not yet without receiving men's words—yet from the chief councilors down they curry favor and do not speak, and those who speak do not exert force; none is what loves Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 其心豈以此爲當而不必言哉？

translations.literal: Can their hearts truly think this fitting and therefore not need to speak?
translations.idiomatic: Can their hearts truly think this fitting and therefore not need to speak?

sentences.zh: 直以陛下爲不足以望堯、舜、禹、湯、文、武之主，而以漢武、明皇待陛下也。

translations.literal: They straightway take Your Majesty as not sufficient to hope for rulers like Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu, and treat Your Majesty as Emperor Wu and Emperor Mingzong.
translations.idiomatic: They straightway take Your Majesty as not sufficient to hope for rulers like Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu, and treat Your Majesty as Emperor Wu and Emperor Mingzong.

sentences.zh: 以材署昭慶軍節度掌書記，由學官試館職。

translations.literal: By talent he was appointed secretary of the Zhaoging Military Commission, and through the academic officer route tested for archive posts.
translations.idiomatic: By talent he was appointed secretary of the Zhaoging Military Commission, and through the academic officer route tested for archive posts.

sentences.zh: 鹹淳三年，拜監察御史，論內降恩澤曰：

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianchun he was appointed investigating censor and discussed inner descent favor grants, saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianchun he was appointed investigating censor and discussed inner descent favor grants, saying:

sentences.zh: 治天下之要，莫先於謹命令，謹命令之要，莫先於窒內批。

translations.literal: The key to governing all under heaven is first to be strict in commands; the key to being strict in commands is first to block inner drafts.
translations.idiomatic: The key to governing all under heaven is first to be strict in commands; the key to being strict in commands is first to block inner drafts.

sentences.zh: 命令，帝王之樞機，必經中書參試，門下封駁，然後付尚書省施行，凡不由三省施行者，名曰「斜封墨敕」，不足效也。

translations.literal: Commands are the pivot of emperors and kings; they must pass through the Secretariat for consultation and trial and the Chancellery for seal and rejection, then be sent to the Ministry of Revenue for implementation; whatever is not implemented through the three departments is called "slanting seal and ink edict" and is not worth imitating.
translations.idiomatic: Commands are the pivot of emperors and kings; they must pass through the Secretariat for consultation and trial and the Chancellery for seal and rejection, then be sent to the Ministry of Revenue for implementation; whatever is not implemented through the three departments is called "slanting seal and ink edict" and is not worth imitating.

sentences.zh: 臣睹陛下自郊祀慶成以來，恩數綢繆，指揮煩數，今日內批，明日內批，邸報之間，以內批行者居其半，竊爲陛下惜之。

translations.literal: Your servant sees that since Your Majesty's suburban sacrifice and celebration of completion, favor has been dense and directives numerous—today an inner draft, tomorrow an inner draft; among court gazette reports, those carried out by inner draft make up half; your servant grieves for Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant sees that since Your Majesty's suburban sacrifice and celebration of completion, favor has been dense and directives numerous—today an inner draft, tomorrow an inner draft; among court gazette reports, those carried out by inner draft make up half; your servant grieves for Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 出納朕命載於《書》，出納王命詠於《詩》，不專言出而必言納者，蓋以命令系朝廷之大，不能皆中乎理，於是有出而復有納焉。

translations.literal: Issuing and receiving the ruler's commands is recorded in the Documents; issuing and receiving the king's commands is sung in the Odes—not speaking only of issuing but necessarily also of receiving—because commands concern what is great in the court and cannot all hit reason; therefore there is issuing and again receiving.
translations.idiomatic: Issuing and receiving the ruler's commands is recorded in the Documents; issuing and receiving the king's commands is sung in the Odes—not speaking only of issuing but necessarily also of receiving—because commands concern what is great in the court and cannot all hit reason; therefore there is issuing and again receiving.

sentences.zh: 祖宗時，禁中處分軍國事付外者謂之內批，如取太原、下江南，韓琦袖以進呈，英宗悚然避坐，此豈非謹內批之原哉？

translations.literal: In the ancestors' time, dispositions in the forbidden palace on military and state affairs sent outside were called inner drafts—such as taking Taiyuan and descending on Jiangnan; Han Qi drew them from his sleeve and presented them; Emperor Yingzong started in alarm and yielded his seat—is this not the origin of being strict with inner drafts?
translations.idiomatic: In the ancestors' time, dispositions in the forbidden palace on military and state affairs sent outside were called inner drafts—such as taking Taiyuan and descending on Jiangnan; Han Qi drew them from his sleeve and presented them; Emperor Yingzong started in alarm and yielded his seat—is this not the origin of being strict with inner drafts?

sentences.zh: 臣日夜念此，以爲官爵陛下之官爵，三省陛下之三省，所謂同奉聖旨，則是三省之出命，即出陛下之命也，豈必內批而後爲恩？

translations.literal: Your servant day and night thinks on this: office and rank are Your Majesty's office and rank, the three departments are Your Majesty's three departments; what is called jointly receiving the sacred edict is then the three departments' issuing command—that is issuing Your Majesty's command—must there be an inner draft before it becomes favor?
translations.idiomatic: Your servant day and night thinks on this: office and rank are Your Majesty's office and rank, the three departments are Your Majesty's three departments; what is called jointly receiving the sacred edict is then the three departments' issuing command—that is issuing Your Majesty's command—must there be an inner draft before it becomes favor?

sentences.zh: 緣情起事，以義制欲，某事當行，某事當息，具有條貫，何不自三省行之，其有未穆於公論者，許令執奏，顧不韙歟。

translations.literal: Acting from feeling to raise affairs, using righteousness to restrain desire—what ought to be done and what ought to cease have their regulations; why not examine yourself in three ways and carry them out? Where they do not accord with public judgment, allow memorials to be submitted—is this not contrary to propriety?
translations.idiomatic: Act from principle, restrain desire by righteousness—what ought to be done and what ought to cease have their regulations; why not examine yourself and carry them out? Where they do not accord with public judgment, allow memorials—is this not contrary to propriety?

sentences.zh: 元祐間，三省言李用和等改官移鎮恩例，今高氏、朱氏，皆舉故事，皇太后曰：「外家恩澤，方欲除損，又可增長乎？」

translations.literal: In the Yuanyou period the three departments said that Li Yonghe and others, in changing office and transferring fiefs, followed precedent; now the Gao and Zhu clans both cite precedent; the Empress Dowager said: "Favor to the maternal kin—we were just about to reduce it—how can it grow again?"
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanyou period the three departments said that Li Yonghe and others, in changing office and transferring fiefs, followed precedent; now the Gao and Zhu clans both cite precedent; the Empress Dowager said: "Favor to the maternal kin—we were just about to reduce it—how can it grow again?"

sentences.zh: 治平初，欲加曹佾使相，皇太后再三不許；

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhiping they wished to add Cao Yi as envoy; the Empress Dowager repeatedly did not permit;
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhiping they wished to add Cao Yi as envoy; the Empress Dowager repeatedly did not permit;

sentences.zh: 又有聖旨，令皇后本家分析親的骨肉聞奏，亦與推恩，司馬光力諫，以爲皇太后既損抑外親，則後族亦恐未宜褒進。

translations.literal: there was also a sacred edict ordering the empress's family to analyze close and distant kin and report—also to extend favor; Sima Guang strenuously remonstrated, thinking that since the Empress Dowager had already restrained the maternal kin, the empress's clan also perhaps ought not be praised and advanced.
translations.idiomatic: there was also a sacred edict ordering the empress's family to analyze close and distant kin and report—also to extend favor; Sima Guang strenuously remonstrated, thinking that since the Empress Dowager had already restrained the maternal kin, the empress's clan also perhaps ought not be praised and advanced.

sentences.zh: 乃今前之恩數未竟，後之恩數已乘。

translations.literal: Now the former favor grants are not yet finished and later favor grants already multiply.
translations.idiomatic: Now the former favor grants are not yet finished and later favor grants already multiply.

sentences.zh: 宰執懼有所專而不敢奏，給舍、台諫懼有所忤而不敢言，更如此者數年，將何以爲國？

translations.literal: The chief councilors fear to memorialize on what concerns them alone; the drafting secretaries and censorate fear to speak from offense; if this continues for several years, how will one govern the state?
translations.idiomatic: The chief councilors fear to memorialize on what concerns them alone; the drafting secretaries and censorate fear to speak from offense; if this continues for several years, how will one govern the state?

sentences.zh: 故政事由中書則治，不由中書則亂，天下事當與天下共之，非人主所可得私也。

translations.literal: Therefore when administration goes through the Secretariat there is order; when it does not go through the Secretariat there is disorder; affairs of all under heaven ought to be shared with all under heaven—not something the ruler can privately obtain.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when administration goes through the Secretariat there is order; when it does not there is disorder; affairs of all under heaven ought to be shared with all under heaven—not something the ruler can privately obtain.

sentences.zh: 四年，改正字，言：「正學不明則義理日微，異端不息則鼓惑轉熾。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was made rectifier and spoke: "When orthodox learning is not bright, principle daily wanes; when heterodox schools do not cease, delusion and agitation grow ever fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was made rectifier and spoke: "When orthodox learning is not bright, principle daily wanes; when heterodox schools do not cease, delusion grows ever fiercer.

sentences.zh: 臣非不知犯顏逆耳，臣子所難，實以君德世道，重有關係，不容不懇惻開陳。

translations.literal: Your servant is not without knowing that to offend the countenance and oppose the ear is difficult for ministers and sons—yet ruler's virtue and the age's way heavily bear on this and must be earnestly set forth.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant is not without knowing that to offend the countenance is difficult for ministers—yet ruler's virtue and the age's way heavily bear on this and must be earnestly set forth.

sentences.zh: 疏上踰日，未蒙付外。

translations.literal: More than a day after the memorial was submitted it had not yet been sent outside.
translations.idiomatic: More than a day after the memorial was submitted it had not yet been sent outside.

sentences.zh: 孟軻有云：'有言責者，不得其言則去'。

translations.literal: Mencius said: "He who has the charge of speech, if he cannot obtain speech, departs."
translations.idiomatic: Mencius said: "He who has the charge of speech, if he cannot obtain speech, departs."

sentences.zh: 臣忝職諫省，義當盡言，今既不得其言，若更貪慕恩榮，不思引去，不惟有負朝廷設官之意，其于孟軻明訓，實亦有慊。」

translations.literal: Your servant disgraces the office of the remonstrance bureau and by righteousness ought to speak fully; now that speech cannot be obtained, if I further covet favor and glory and do not think of withdrawal, I not only fail the court's intent in establishing offices—in Mencius's clear instruction I also have shame."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant disgraces the office of the remonstrance bureau and by righteousness ought to speak fully; now that speech cannot be obtained, if I further covet favor and glory and do not withdraw, I not only fail the court's intent—in Mencius's clear instruction I also have shame."

sentences.zh: 會丁父憂去位，服除，授集英殿修撰，沿海制置、知慶元府事。

translations.literal: When his father's mourning came he left office; when mourning ended he was appointed compiler at the Hall for Assembling Excellence, coastal commissioner, and prefect of Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: When his father's mourning came he left office; when mourning ended he was appointed compiler at the Hall for Assembling Excellence, coastal commissioner, and prefect of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 建濟民莊，以濟士民之急，資貢士春官之費，備郡庠耆老緩急之需。

translations.literal: He founded the Relief-the-People estate to relieve scholars and commoners in urgency, fund gentlemen's spring examination expenses, and supply the prefectural school and elders' urgent needs.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the Relief-the-People estate to relieve scholars and commoners in urgency, fund gentlemen's spring examination expenses, and supply the prefectural school and elders' urgent needs.

sentences.zh: 又請建慈湖書院。

translations.literal: He also requested to build the Cihu Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested to build the Cihu Academy.

sentences.zh: 八年，召還，拜刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was recalled and appointed vice minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was recalled and appointed vice minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 九年，改朝奉郎，試吏部尚書，兼工部尚書，兼中書舍人，兼修玉牒，兼侍讀。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was changed to court gentleman for attendance and tested as minister of Personnel, concurrently minister of Works, drafting secretary, compiler of the imperial genealogy, and lecturer-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was changed to court gentleman for attendance and tested as minister of Personnel, concurrently minister of Works, drafting secretary, compiler of the imperial genealogy, and lecturer-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 上疏請給王十朋祠堂田土。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial requesting grant of temple estate land for Wang Shipeng.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial requesting grant of temple estate land for Wang Shipeng.

sentences.zh: 十年，丁母憂。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he mourned his mother.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he mourned his mother.

sentences.zh: 明年，江上潰師，丞相陳宜中起復黻爲端明殿學士，不起，及賈似道，韓震死，宜中謀擁二王由溫州入海，以兵逆黻共政，將遜相位，於是黻托宗祀于母弟成伯，遂起，及羅浮，以疾卒。

translations.literal: The next year the army on the river collapsed; Chief Councilor Chen Yizhong recalled Fu as academician of the Duanming Hall; he did not rise; when Jia Sidao and Han Zhen died, Yizhong plotted to take the two princes from Wenzhou by sea and by force compelled Fu to share government, about to yield the councilor's post—then Fu entrusted the ancestral sacrifice to his younger brother Chengbai, rose, and at Luofu died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the army on the river collapsed; Chief Councilor Chen Yizhong recalled Fu as academician of the Duanming Hall; he did not rise; when Jia Sidao and Han Zhen died, Yizhong plotted to take the two princes from Wenzhou by sea and by force compelled Fu to share government, about to yield the councilor's post—then Fu entrusted the ancestral sacrifice to his younger brother Chengbai, rose, and at Luofu died of illness.

sentences.zh: 初，陳宜中夢人告之曰：「今年天災流行，人死且半，服大黃者生。」

translations.literal: Earlier Chen Yizhong dreamed a man told him: "This year pestilence spreads; half the people will die—those who take rhubarb live."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Chen Yizhong dreamed a man told him: "This year pestilence spreads; half the people will die—those who take rhubarb live."

sentences.zh: 繼而疫癘大作，服者果得不死，及黻病，宜中令服之，終莫能救。

translations.literal: Then epidemic illness broke out on a great scale; those who took it indeed did not die; when Fu fell ill Yizhong ordered him to take it but in the end could not save him.
translations.idiomatic: Then epidemic illness broke out on a great scale; those who took it indeed did not die; when Fu fell ill Yizhong ordered him to take it but in the end could not save him.

sentences.zh: 其配林氏舉家蹈海。

translations.literal: His wife the Lady Lin led the whole family into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Lin led the whole family into the sea.

sentences.zh: 未幾，海上事亦瓦解矣。

translations.literal: Before long affairs at sea also collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long affairs at sea also collapsed.

sentences.zh: 黻有《蒙川集》十卷行於世。

translations.literal: Fu had the Mengchuan Collection in ten juan circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Fu left the Mengchuan Collection in ten juan circulating in his time.

sentences.zh: 王居安

translations.literal: Wang Juan
translations.idiomatic: Wang Juan

sentences.zh: 王居安，字資道，黃岩人。

translations.literal: Wang Juan, style name Zidao, was a native of Huangyan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Juan, courtesy name Zidao, came from Huangyan.

sentences.zh: 始名居敬，字簡卿，避祧廟嫌易之。

translations.literal: His original name was Jujing, style name Jianqing; he changed it to avoid the taboo of the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Jujing, courtesy name Jianqing; he changed it to avoid the taboo of the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 始能言，讀《孝經》，有從旁指曰：「曉此乎？」

translations.literal: When he first could speak he read the Classic of Filial Piety; someone at his side pointed and said: "Do you understand this?"
translations.idiomatic: When he first could speak he read the Classic of Filial Piety; someone at his side pointed and said: "Do you understand this?"

sentences.zh: 即答曰：「夫子教人孝耳。」

translations.literal: He immediately answered: "The Master teaches people filial piety."
translations.idiomatic: He immediately answered: "The Master teaches people filial piety."

sentences.zh: 劉孝韙七月八日過其家塾，見居安異凡兒，使賦八夕詩，援筆成之，有思致。

translations.literal: On the eighth day of the seventh month Liu Xiaokui passed his family school, saw Juan was an extraordinary child, had him compose a poem on the eight evenings; he took up the brush and completed it with thought.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth day of the seventh month Liu Xiaokui passed his family school, saw Juan was an extraordinary child, had him compose a poem on the eight evenings; he took up the brush and completed it with thought.

sentences.zh: 孝韙驚拊其背曰：「子異日名位必過我。」

translations.literal: Xiaokui in alarm patted his back and said: "Your fame and rank another day will surpass mine."
translations.idiomatic: Xiaokui in alarm patted his back and said: "Your fame and rank another day will surpass mine."

sentences.zh: 入太學，淳熙十四年舉進士，授徽州推官，連遭內外艱，柄國者以居安十年不調，將徑授職事官，居安自請試民事，乃授江東提刑司幹官。

translations.literal: He entered the Imperial Academy; in the fourteenth year of Chunxi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed judicial officer of Huizhou; he twice suffered inner and outer mourning; those holding power, because Juan went ten years without transfer, were about to directly grant a functional office—Juan himself requested to test civil affairs and was then appointed staff officer of the Jiangdong Judicial Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Imperial Academy; in the fourteenth year of Chunxi he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed judicial officer of Huizhou; he twice suffered inner and outer mourning; those holding power, because Juan went ten years without transfer, were about to directly grant a functional office—Juan himself requested to test civil affairs and was then appointed staff officer of the Jiangdong Judicial Commission.

sentences.zh: 使者王厚之厲鋒氣，人莫敢嬰，居安遇事有不可，平面力爭不少屈。

translations.literal: The commissioner Wang Houzhi had fierce spirit; no one dared touch him; Juan when affairs were not permissible faced him and strove without slight yielding.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner Wang Houzhi had fierce spirit; no one dared touch him; Juan when affairs were not permissible faced him and strove without slight yielding.

sentences.zh: 入爲國子正、太學博士。

translations.literal: He entered as director of the Directorate of Education and erudite of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He entered as director of the Directorate of Education and erudite of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 入對，首言：「人主當以知人安民爲要，人未易知，必擇宰輔侍從之賢，使引其類；

translations.literal: On audience he first spoke: "The ruler ought to take knowing men and securing the people as essential; men are not easy to know—one must choose worthy chief councilors and attendants-in-waiting to lead their kind;
translations.idiomatic: On audience he first spoke: "The ruler ought to take knowing men and securing the people as essential; men are not easy to know—one must choose worthy chief councilors and attendants-in-waiting to lead their kind;

sentences.zh: 民未易安，必求愷悌循良之吏，以布其澤。」

translations.literal: the people are not easy to secure—one must seek kindly and upright officials to spread their grace."
translations.idiomatic: the people are not easy to secure—one must seek kindly and upright officials to spread their grace."

sentences.zh: 次言：「火政不修，罪在京尹，軍律不明，罪在殿、步兩司，罪鈞異罰固不可，安有薄罰一步帥而二人置弗問乎？」

translations.literal: Next he spoke: "Fire administration is not repaired—the fault lies with the capital intendant; military discipline is not clear—the fault lies with the palace and step armies; crimes equal but punishments different is certainly not permissible—how can there be light punishment for one step commander while two men are left unquestioned?"
translations.idiomatic: Next he spoke: "Fire administration is not repaired—the fault lies with the capital intendant; military discipline is not clear—the fault lies with the palace and step armies; crimes equal but punishments different is certainly not permissible—how can there be light punishment for one step commander while two men are left unquestioned?"

sentences.zh: 遷校書郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to collator.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to collator.

sentences.zh: 居安乞召試，言：「祖宗時惟進士第一不試，蘇軾以高科負重名，英宗欲授館職，韓琦猶執不從。」

translations.literal: Juan begged to be summoned for examination and spoke: "In the ancestors' time only the jinshi first place did not test; Su Shi with high rank bore heavy name—Emperor Yingzong wished to grant archive posts and Han Qi still firmly did not comply."
translations.idiomatic: Juan begged to be summoned for examination and spoke: "In the ancestors' time only the jinshi first place did not test; Su Shi with high rank bore heavy name—Emperor Yingzong wished to grant archive posts and Han Qi still firmly did not comply."

sentences.zh: 執政謂居安曰：「朝廷于節度尚不較，況館職乎？」

translations.literal: Those in power said to Juan: "The court does not haggle over military commissions—how much more archive posts?"
translations.idiomatic: Those in power said to Juan: "The court does not haggle over military commissions—how much more archive posts?"

sentences.zh: 居安因言：「節鉞之重，文非位極，武非勳高，胡可妄得。

translations.literal: Juan therefore spoke: "The weight of command seals—if civil rank is not extreme and martial merit not high, how can it be rashly obtained?
translations.idiomatic: Juan therefore spoke: "The weight of command seals—if civil rank is not extreme and martial merit not high, how can it be rashly obtained?

sentences.zh: 丞相言不較，過矣。」

translations.literal: The chief councilor's saying he does not haggle is excessive."
translations.idiomatic: The chief councilor's saying he does not haggle is excessive."

sentences.zh: 時蘇師旦命且下，故居安言及之。

translations.literal: At the time Su Shidan's appointment was about to descend—therefore Juan spoke of it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Su Shidan's appointment was about to descend—therefore Juan spoke of it.

sentences.zh: 改司農丞。

translations.literal: He was changed to vice director of the Directorate of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to vice director of the Directorate of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 御史迎意論劾，主管仙都觀。

translations.literal: The censor curried favor and impeached him; he was put in charge of the Xiandu Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: The censor curried favor and impeached him; he was put in charge of the Xiandu Abbey.

sentences.zh: 踰年，起知興化軍。

translations.literal: Within the year he was raised to know Xinghua Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Within the year he was raised to know Xinghua Circuit.

sentences.zh: 既至，條奏便民事，乞行經界。

translations.literal: When he arrived he set forth convenient measures for the people item by item and begged to carry out the field-boundary system.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived he set forth convenient measures for the people item by item and begged to carry out the field-boundary system.

sentences.zh: 且言：「蕃舶多得香犀象翠，崇侈俗，泄銅鏹，有損無益，宜遏絕禁止。」

translations.literal: Moreover he spoke: "Foreign ships often obtain fragrant rhinoceros horn, ivory, and kingfisher feathers, promoting extravagant custom and leaking copper cash—more harm than benefit; it ought to be stopped and forbidden."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover he spoke: "Foreign ships often obtain fragrant rhinoceros horn, ivory, and kingfisher feathers, promoting extravagant custom and leaking copper cash—more harm than benefit; it ought to be stopped and forbidden."

sentences.zh: 皆要務也。

translations.literal: All were important affairs.
translations.idiomatic: All were important affairs.

sentences.zh: 通商賈以損米價，誅劇盜以去民害。

translations.literal: He opened trade with merchants to lower rice prices and executed fierce bandits to remove harm to the people.
translations.idiomatic: He opened trade with merchants to lower rice prices and executed fierce bandits to remove harm to the people.

sentences.zh: 召爲秘書丞。

translations.literal: He was summoned as secretary in the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as secretary in the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 轉對，言：「置宣司，不聞進取之良規；

translations.literal: On rotated audience he spoke: "The Pacification Commission was established—one does not hear good plans for advance;
translations.idiomatic: On rotated audience he spoke: "The Pacification Commission was established—one does not hear good plans for advance;

sentences.zh: 遣小使，寂無確許之實報。

translations.literal: small envoys are sent—in silence there is no solid report of what is promised.
translations.idiomatic: small envoys are sent—in silence there is no solid report of what is promised.

sentences.zh: 但當嚴飭守備，益兵據險以待之，此廟算之上也。」

translations.literal: One ought only strictly order defense preparations, increase troops and hold strategic places to await them—this is the highest of temple calculations."
translations.idiomatic: One ought only strictly order defense preparations, increase troops and hold strategic places to await them—this is the highest of temple calculations."

sentences.zh: 李壁嘗語人曰：「比年論疆事無若王秘丞之明白者。」

translations.literal: Li Bi once told others: "In recent years none who discuss frontier affairs is as clear as Vice Director Wang."
translations.idiomatic: Li Bi once told others: "In recent years none who discuss frontier affairs is as clear as Vice Director Wang."

sentences.zh: 遷著作郎兼國史實錄院檢討編修官，兼權考功郎官。

translations.literal: He was transferred to compiler with concurrent appointment as revising and compiling officer of the Veritable Records and acting director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to compiler with concurrent appointment as revising and compiling officer of the Veritable Records and acting director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 誅韓侂胄，居安實贊其決。

translations.literal: When Han Tuozhou was executed Juan in fact approved the decision.
translations.idiomatic: When Han Tuozhou was executed Juan in fact approved the decision.

sentences.zh: 翼日，擢右司諫。

translations.literal: The next day he was elevated to remonstrance officer of the Right Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he was elevated to remonstrance officer of the Right Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 首論：

translations.literal: He first discussed:
translations.idiomatic: He first discussed:

sentences.zh: 侂胄以預聞內禪之功，竊取大權，童奴濫授以節鉞，嬖妾竄籍於官庭。

translations.literal: Tuozhou, by foreknowledge of the merit of the inner abdication, stole great power; boy slaves were indiscriminately granted command seals, favorite concubines sneaked into official registers.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou, by foreknowledge of the merit of the inner abdication, stole great power; boy slaves were indiscriminately granted command seals, favorite concubines sneaked into official registers.

sentences.zh: 創造亭館，震驚太廟之山；

translations.literal: He created pavilions and halls, shaking the mountains of the Imperial Ancestral Temple;
translations.idiomatic: He created pavilions and halls, shaking the mountains of the Imperial Ancestral Temple;

sentences.zh: 燕樂語笑，徹聞神御之所，忽慢宗廟，罪宜萬死。

translations.literal: banquet music and laughter penetrated where the spirit tablets dwelt—suddenly slighting the ancestral temple, the crime deserves ten thousand deaths.
translations.idiomatic: banquet music and laughter penetrated where the spirit tablets dwelt—suddenly slighting the ancestral temple, the crime deserves ten thousand deaths.

sentences.zh: 托以大臣之薦，盡取軍國之權。

translations.literal: Under pretext of great ministers' recommendation he took all military and state power.
translations.idiomatic: Under pretext of great ministers' recommendation he took all military and state power.

sentences.zh: 台諫、侍從，惟意是用，不恤公議；

translations.literal: The censorate, remonstrance bureaus, and attendants-in-waiting were used as he pleased, not caring for public judgment;
translations.idiomatic: The censorate, remonstrance bureaus, and attendants-in-waiting were used as he pleased, not caring for public judgment;

sentences.zh: 親黨姻婭，躐取美官，不問流品；

translations.literal: kin by marriage and affinity leaped to obtain fine offices without asking pedigree;
translations.idiomatic: kin by marriage and affinity leaped to obtain fine offices without asking pedigree;

sentences.zh: 名器僭濫，動違成法。

translations.literal: names and vessels were usurped and excessive, moving in violation of established law.
translations.idiomatic: names and vessels were usurped and excessive, moving in violation of established law.

sentences.zh: 竊弄威柄，妄開邊隙。

translations.literal: He secretly wielded authority and rashly opened border troubles.
translations.idiomatic: He secretly wielded authority and rashly opened border troubles.

sentences.zh: 自兵端一啟，南北生靈，壯者死鋒刃，弱者填溝壑。

translations.literal: Once the spearhead of war was raised, north and south living souls—the strong died on blades, the weak filled ditches and gullies.
translations.idiomatic: Once the spearhead of war was raised, north and south living souls—the strong died on blades, the weak filled ditches and gullies.

sentences.zh: 荊襄、兩淮之地，暴屍盈野，號哭震天。

translations.literal: In Jingxiang and the two Huai regions exposed corpses filled the fields and cries of lament shook heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingxiang and the two Huai regions exposed corpses filled the fields and cries of lament shook heaven.

sentences.zh: 軍需百費，科擾州縣，海內騷然。

translations.literal: Military needs and a hundred expenses harassed prefectures and counties; within the seas there was turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: Military needs and a hundred expenses harassed prefectures and counties; within the seas there was turmoil.

sentences.zh: 跡其罪狀，人怨神怒，衆情洶洶，物議沸騰，而侂胄箝制中外，罔使陛下聞知，宦官宮妾，皆其私人，莫肯爲陛下言者。

translations.literal: Tracing his crimes, men resented and spirits were angry; popular feeling was turbulent and public discussion seethed—yet Tuozhou clamped inside and outside and did not let Your Majesty know; eunuchs and palace women were all his private persons and none would speak for Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Tracing his crimes, men resented and spirits were angry; popular feeling was turbulent and public discussion seethed—yet Tuozhou clamped inside and outside and did not let Your Majesty know; eunuchs and palace women were all his private persons and none would speak for Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 西蜀吳氏，世掌重兵，頃緣吳挺之死，朝廷取其兵柄，改畀它將，其策至善。

translations.literal: The Wu clan of western Shu for generations held heavy troops; recently because of Wu Ting's death the court took their military handle and changed to other generals—the plan was most good.
translations.idiomatic: The Wu clan of western Shu for generations held heavy troops. Recently because of Wu Ting's death the court took their military handle and changed to other generals—the plan was most good.

sentences.zh: 侂胄與曦結爲死黨，假之節鉞，復授以全蜀兵權。

translations.literal: Tuozhou formed a death bond with Xi and lent him command seals, again granting all Shu's military power.
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou formed a death bond with Xi and lent him command seals, again granting all Shu's military power.

sentences.zh: 曦之叛逆，罪將誰歸？

translations.literal: Xi's rebellion—to whom will the crime return?
translations.idiomatic: Xi's rebellion—to whom will the crime return?

sentences.zh: 使曦不死，侂胄未可知也。

translations.literal: If Xi had not died, Tuozhou would still be unknowable.
translations.idiomatic: If Xi had not died, Tuozhou would still be unknowable.

sentences.zh: 侂胄數年之間，位極三公，列爵爲王，外則專制東西二府之權，內則窺伺宮禁之嚴，奸心逆節，具有顯狀。

translations.literal: Within several years Tuozhou's rank reached the three excellencies and he was enfeoffed as king; outwardly he monopolized the power of the eastern and western bureaus, inwardly he peeped at the strictness of the palace forbidden—treacherous heart and rebellious conduct had clear manifestations.
translations.idiomatic: Within several years Tuozhou's rank reached the three excellencies and he was enfeoffed as king; outwardly he monopolized the power of the eastern and western bureaus, inwardly he peeped at the strictness of the palace forbidden—treacherous heart and rebellious conduct had clear manifestations.

sentences.zh: 縱使侂胄身膏斧鉞，猶有餘罪，況兵釁未解，朝廷儻不明正典刑，何以昭國法，何以示敵人，何以謝天下？

translations.literal: Even if Tuozhou's body were greased on the axe, there would still be surplus crime—moreover military troubles are not yet resolved; if the court perhaps does not clarify canonical punishment, how will it display state law, show the enemy, and apologize to all under heaven?
translations.idiomatic: Even if Tuozhou's body were greased on the axe, there would still be surplus crime—moreover military troubles are not yet resolved; if the court perhaps does not clarify canonical punishment, how will it display state law, show the enemy, and apologize to all under heaven?

sentences.zh: 今誠取侂胄肆諸市朝，是戮一人而千萬人獲安其生也。

translations.literal: Now if we truly take Tuozhou and expose him in the marketplace, this is executing one man and ten thousand men obtain peace in their lives.
translations.idiomatic: Now if we truly take Tuozhou and expose him in the marketplace, this is executing one man and ten thousand men obtain peace in their lives.

sentences.zh: 侂胄既有非常之罪，當伏非常之誅，詎可以常典論哉？

translations.literal: Tuozhou already has extraordinary crime and ought to suffer extraordinary execution—how can one discuss him by the ordinary code?
translations.idiomatic: Tuozhou already has extraordinary crime and ought to suffer extraordinary execution—how can one discuss him by the ordinary code?

sentences.zh: 右丞相陳自強素行污濁，老益貪鄙，徒以貧賤私交，自一縣丞超遷，徑至宰輔，奸憸附麗，黷亂國經。

translations.literal: The right chief councilor Chen Ziqiang's conduct was always filthy; old he grew more greedy and base; he rose from a single county assistant by poor and low private friendship straight to chief councilor, wicked and fawning attached, defiling and disordering state constants.
translations.idiomatic: The right chief councilor Chen Ziqiang's conduct was always filthy; old he grew more greedy and base; he rose from a single county assistant by poor and low private friendship straight to chief councilor, wicked and fawning attached, defiling and disordering state constants.

sentences.zh: 較其罪惡，與侂胄相去無幾。

translations.literal: Comparing his crimes and wickedness, the distance from Tuozhou is not great.
translations.idiomatic: Comparing his crimes and wickedness, the distance from Tuozhou is not great.

sentences.zh: 乞追責遠竄，以爲爲臣不忠、朋邪誤國者之戒。

translations.literal: I beg to pursue blame and banish far, as a warning to ministers who are not loyal and factional evil that harms the state.
translations.idiomatic: I beg to pursue blame and banish far, as a warning to ministers who are not loyal and factional evil that harms the state.

sentences.zh: 又劾曦外姻郭倪、郭僎，竄嶺表，天下快之。

translations.literal: He also impeached Xi's affines by marriage Guo Ni and Guo Chen, banished to the outer ranges—all under heaven were pleased.
translations.idiomatic: He also impeached Xi's affines by marriage Guo Ni and Guo Chen, banished to the outer ranges—all under heaven were pleased.

sentences.zh: 繼兼侍講。

translations.literal: He then held concurrent appointment as lecturer-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: He then held concurrent appointment as lecturer-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 方侂胄用事，箝天下之口，使不得議己，太府寺丞呂祖儉以謫死，布衣呂祖泰上書直言，中以危法，流之遠郡。

translations.literal: When Tuozhou held power he clamped the mouths of all under heaven so they could not discuss him; the Court of the Imperial Treasury vice director Lü Zuyijian died from demotion; the commoner Lü Zutai submitted a memorial with straight speech and was hit with the dangerous law, exiled to a distant prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Tuozhou held power he clamped the mouths of all under heaven so they could not discuss him; the Court of the Imperial Treasury vice director Lü Zuyijian died from demotion; the commoner Lü Zutai submitted a memorial with straight speech and was hit with the dangerous law, exiled to a distant prefecture.

sentences.zh: 居安奏請明其冤，以伸忠鯁之氣。

translations.literal: Juan memorialized requesting to clarify their wrongs to extend the spirit of loyal lodged speech.
translations.idiomatic: Juan memorialized requesting to clarify their wrongs to extend the spirit of loyal lodged speech.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「古今之治本亂階，更爲倚伏。

translations.literal: He also submitted a memorial saying: "The roots of order and chaos in ancient and modern times more alternately lean and lie.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted a memorial saying: "The roots of order and chaos in ancient and modern times more alternately lean and lie.

sentences.zh: 以治易亂則反掌而可治，以亂治亂則亂去而復生。

translations.literal: To change disorder with order is to turn the palm and order is achieved; to govern disorder with disorder is that when disorder departs it is born again.
translations.idiomatic: To change disorder with order is to turn the palm and order is achieved; to govern disorder with disorder is that when disorder departs it is born again.

sentences.zh: 人主公聽則治，偏信則亂；

translations.literal: When the ruler publicly listens there is order; when he partially believes there is disorder;
translations.idiomatic: When the ruler publicly listens there is order; when he partially believes there is disorder;

sentences.zh: 政事歸外朝則治，歸內廷則亂；

translations.literal: when administration returns to the outer court there is order; when it returns to the inner court there is disorder;
translations.idiomatic: when administration returns to the outer court there is order; when it returns to the inner court there is disorder;

sentences.zh: 問百辟士大夫則治，問左右近習則亂；

translations.literal: when one asks the hundred ministers and great officials there is order; when one asks those near and favorites there is disorder;
translations.idiomatic: when one asks the hundred ministers and great officials there is order; when one asks those near and favorites there is disorder;

sentences.zh: 大臣公心無党則治，植黨行私則亂；

translations.literal: when great ministers have public hearts without factions there is order; when they plant factions and act privately there is disorder;
translations.idiomatic: when great ministers have public hearts without factions there is order; when they plant factions and act privately there is disorder;

sentences.zh: 大臣正、小臣廉則治，大臣汙、小臣貪則亂。

translations.literal: when great ministers are upright and petty ministers honest there is order; when great ministers are filthy and petty ministers greedy there is disorder.
translations.idiomatic: when great ministers are upright and petty ministers honest there is order; when great ministers are filthy and petty ministers greedy there is disorder.

sentences.zh: 如用人稍誤，是一侂胄死，一侂胄生也。」

translations.literal: If in employing men there is slight error, it is one Tuozhou dead and one Tuozhou born."
translations.idiomatic: If in employing men there is slight error, it is one Tuozhou dead and one Tuozhou born."

sentences.zh: 趙彥逾與樓鑰、林大中、章燮並召，居安言：「鑰與大中用，宗廟社稷之靈，天下蒼生之福，彥逾不可與之同日而語。

translations.literal: Zhao Yanyu was summoned together with Lou Yue, Lin Dazhong, and Zhang Xie; Juan spoke: "Yue and Dazhong employed are the spirits of the altars of state and the blessing of the black-haired people—Yanyu cannot be spoken of on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanyu was summoned together with Lou Yue, Lin Dazhong, and Zhang Xie; Juan spoke: "Yue and Dazhong employed are the spirits of the altars of state and the blessing of the black-haired people—Yanyu cannot be spoken of on the same day.

sentences.zh: 彥逾始以趙汝愚不與同列政地，遂啟侂胄專政之謀，汝愚之斥死，彥逾之力居多，而彥逾者，汝愚之罪人也。

translations.literal: Yanyu at first because Zhao Ruyu did not share the same rank in the administration opened Tuozhou's plot for monopolizing power; Ruyu's dismissal and death—Yanyu's force was mostly in it—and Yanyu is Ruyu's criminal.
translations.idiomatic: Yanyu at first because Zhao Ruyu did not share the same rank in the administration opened Tuozhou's plot for monopolizing power; Ruyu's dismissal and death—Yanyu's force was mostly in it—and Yanyu is Ruyu's criminal.

sentences.zh: 陛下乃使與二人者同升，不幾於薰蕕同器、邪正並用乎？

translations.literal: Your Majesty yet makes him rise together with the two men—is this not nearly putting stinkweed and orchid in the same vessel, evil and upright employed together?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty yet makes him rise together with the two men—is this not nearly putting stinkweed and orchid in the same vessel, evil and upright employed together?

sentences.zh: 非所以示趨向於天下也。」

translations.literal: This is not what shows tendency to all under heaven."
translations.idiomatic: This is not what shows tendency to all under heaven."

sentences.zh: 疏已具，有微聞者，除目夜下，遷起居郎兼崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: When the memorial was complete, there were those who heard slightly; appointment orders descended at night; he was transferred to attendant recorder with concurrent appointment as lecturer at the Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was complete, there were those who heard slightly; appointment orders descended at night; he was transferred to attendant recorder with concurrent appointment as lecturer at the Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 於是爲諫官才十有八日。

translations.literal: Thus he had been remonstrance officer only eighteen days.
translations.idiomatic: Thus he had been remonstrance officer only eighteen days.

sentences.zh: 既供職，即直前奏日：「陛下特遷臣柱下史者，豈非欲使臣不得言耶？

translations.literal: Having taken up duty, he immediately advanced and memorialized: "Your Majesty specially transferred your servant to attendant censor—is it not that you wish to make your servant unable to speak?
translations.idiomatic: Having taken up duty, he immediately advanced and memorialized: "Your Majesty specially transferred your servant to attendant censor—is it not that you wish to make your servant unable to speak?

sentences.zh: 二史得直前奏事，祖宗法也。」

translations.literal: The two historians may advance and memorialize—this is the ancestors' law."
translations.idiomatic: The two historians may advance and memorialize—this is the ancestors' law."

sentences.zh: 遂極論之，又言：「臣爲陛下耳目官，諫紙未乾，乃以迕權要徙他職，不得其言則去，臣不復留矣。」

translations.literal: He then discussed it to the limit, and also said: "Your servant is Your Majesty's eyes-and-ears officer; the remonstrance paper is not yet dry yet because of offending powerful men you transfer me to another post—if speech cannot be obtained I depart; your servant will not remain."
translations.idiomatic: He then discussed it to the limit, and also said: "Your servant is Your Majesty's eyes-and-ears officer; the remonstrance paper is not yet dry yet because of offending powerful men you transfer me to another post—if speech cannot be obtained I depart; your servant will not remain."

sentences.zh: 帝爲改容。

translations.literal: The Emperor changed countenance.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor changed countenance.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞雷孝友論其越職，奪一官，罷。

translations.literal: The censor-in-chief Lei Xiaoyou discussed his overstepping duty, stripped one rank, and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: The censor-in-chief Lei Xiaoyou discussed his overstepping duty, stripped one rank, and dismissed him.

sentences.zh: 太學諸生有舉幡乞留者。

translations.literal: Students of the Imperial Academy raised banners begging him to stay.
translations.idiomatic: Students of the Imperial Academy raised banners begging him to stay.

sentences.zh: 四明楊簡邂逅山陰道中，謂「此舉吾道增重」。

translations.literal: Yang Jian of Siming met him by chance on the Shanyin road and said: "This act adds weight to our Way."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jian of Siming met him by chance on the Shanyin road and said: "This act adds weight to our Way."

sentences.zh: 江陵項安世致書曰：「左史，人中龍也。」

translations.literal: Xiang Anshi of Jiangling sent a letter saying: "The left historian is a dragon among men."
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Anshi of Jiangling sent a letter saying: "The left historian is a dragon among men."

sentences.zh: 踰年，復官，知太平州。

translations.literal: Within the year he was restored to office and made prefect of Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Within the year he was restored to office and made prefect of Taiping.

sentences.zh: 當邊遽甫定，歲儉，汰去軍群聚寇攘，居安威惠流行，晏然若無事時。

translations.literal: When border emergencies had just settled, the year was lean, and dismissed soldiers gathered in bands to plunder, Juan's authority and kindness spread and it was peaceful as if there were no affair.
translations.idiomatic: When border emergencies had just settled, the year was lean, and dismissed soldiers gathered in bands to plunder, Juan's authority and kindness spread and it was peaceful as if there were no affair.

sentences.zh: 將副劉佑爲怨家詣闕告密，置獄金陵，居安以書抵當路辯其冤，或謂「佑自誣服，得無嫌於黨逆乎？」
