translations.literal: Deputy general Liu You, because of enmity, went to court to inform secretly; he was imprisoned at Jinling; Juan sent a letter to those in power pleading his innocence; some said: "You confessed guilt himself—will there not be suspicion of party treason?"
translations.idiomatic: Deputy general Liu You, because of enmity, went to court to inform secretly; he was imprisoned at Jinling; Juan sent a letter to those in power pleading his innocence; some said: "You confessed guilt himself—will there not be suspicion of party treason?"

sentences.zh: 居安曰：「郡有無辜死，奚以守爲？」

translations.literal: Juan said: "In the prefecture there is death of the innocent—of what use is the prefect?"
translations.idiomatic: Juan said: "In the prefecture there is death of the innocent—of what use is the prefect?"

sentences.zh: 事果白。

translations.literal: The affair in the end was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The affair in the end was cleared.

sentences.zh: 以直龍圖閣提點浙西刑獄。

translations.literal: By direct appointment as academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall he was made judicial intendant of western Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: By direct appointment as academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall he was made judicial intendant of western Zhe.

sentences.zh: 葛懌者，用戚屬恩補官，豪於貲，嘗憾父之嬖，既去而誣以盜，株連瘐死者數人，懌乃未嘗一造庭。

translations.literal: Ge Yi, who used consort kin favor to supplement office, was rich and overbearing; he once resented his father's favorite concubine; after leaving he falsely accused her of theft; several people implicated died in prison from torture; Yi never once came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Yi, who used consort kin favor to supplement office, was rich and overbearing; he once resented his father's favorite concubine; after leaving he falsely accused her of theft; several people implicated died in prison from torture; Yi never once came to court.

sentences.zh: 居安一閱得實，立捕系論罪，械送他州。

translations.literal: Juan on one reading obtained the truth, immediately arrested and bound him for judgment, and sent him in cangue to another prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Juan on one reading obtained the truth, immediately arrested and bound him for judgment, and sent him in cangue to another prefecture.

sentences.zh: 入對，帝曰：「卿有用之才也。」

translations.literal: On audience the Emperor said: "You are a useful talent."
translations.idiomatic: On audience the Emperor said: "You are a useful talent."

sentences.zh: 權工部侍朗，以集英殿修撰知隆興府。

translations.literal: Acting vice minister of Works, as compiler at the Hall for Assembling Excellence he was made prefect of Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: Acting vice minister of Works, as compiler at the Hall for Assembling Excellence he was made prefect of Longxing.

sentences.zh: 初，盜起郴黑風峒，羅世傳爲之倡，勢張甚。

translations.literal: At first bandits rose at Heifeng Cave in Chen; Luo Shichuan was their leader and momentum was very strong.
translations.idiomatic: At first bandits rose at Heifeng Cave in Chen; Luo Shichuan was their leader and momentum was very strong.

sentences.zh: 湖南所在發兵扼要沖，義丁表裏應援，賊乏食，少懈，主兵者稍堅持之，則就禽矣。

translations.literal: Throughout Hunan troops were sent to hold strategic passes; militia responded inside and outside; the bandits lacked food and slackened slightly; if the commanding officers held firm a little they could be captured.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout Hunan troops were sent to hold strategic passes; militia responded inside and outside; the bandits lacked food and slackened slightly; if the commanding officers held firm a little they could be captured.

sentences.zh: 會江西帥欲以買降爲功，遣人間道說賊，饋鹽與糧，賊喜，謀益逞。

translations.literal: It happened that the Jiangxi commander wished to make buying surrender his achievement; he sent men by secret paths to persuade the bandits, presenting salt and grain; the bandits were pleased and their plotting grew bolder.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the Jiangxi commander wished to make buying surrender his achievement; he sent men by secret paths to persuade the bandits, presenting salt and grain; the bandits were pleased and their plotting grew bolder.

sentences.zh: 帥以病卒，繼者蹈其敝。

translations.literal: The commander died of illness; the successor followed his abuses.
translations.idiomatic: The commander died of illness; the successor followed his abuses.

sentences.zh: 賊陰治械，外送款，身受官峒中，不至公府。

translations.literal: The bandits secretly prepared weapons; outwardly they sent expressions of goodwill and personally received office in the cave districts, not coming to the public offices.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits secretly prepared weapons; outwardly they sent expressions of goodwill and personally received office in the cave districts, not coming to the public offices.

sentences.zh: 義丁皆恚曰：「作賊者得官，我輩捐軀壞產業，何所得！」

translations.literal: The militia all resented and said: "Those who make banditry obtain office—we who cast away bodies and ruin property, what do we obtain!"
translations.idiomatic: The militia all resented and said: "Those who make banditry obtain office—we who cast away bodies and ruin property, what do we obtain!"

sentences.zh: 於是五合六聚，各以峒名其鄉，李元勵、陳延佐之徒，並起爲賊矣。

translations.literal: Then five combinations and six gatherings each named their villages by cave; Li Yuanli, Chen Yanzuo, and others all rose as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Then five combinations and six gatherings each named their villages by cave; Li Yuanli, Chen Yanzuo, and others all rose as bandits.

sentences.zh: 放兵四劫，掀永新，撇龍泉，江西列城皆震。

translations.literal: They loosed troops to plunder on four sides, swept Yongxin, brushed Longquan, and prefectures of Jiangxi all trembled.
translations.idiomatic: They loosed troops to plunder on four sides, swept Yongxin, brushed Longquan, and prefectures of Jiangxi all trembled.

sentences.zh: 朝廷調江、鄂之兵屯衡、贛，而他兵駐龍泉者命吉守節制焉。

translations.literal: The court transferred Jiang and E troops to garrison Heng and Gan, and ordered the other troops stationed at Longquan to be under the command of the Ji prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The court transferred Jiang and E troops to garrison Heng and Gan, and ordered the other troops stationed at Longquan to be under the command of the Ji prefect.

sentences.zh: 吉守率師往，幾爲賊困，池兵來援失利。

translations.literal: The Ji prefect led troops and went; he was nearly trapped by bandits; Chi troops came to rescue and lost.
translations.idiomatic: The Ji prefect led troops and went; he was nearly trapped by bandits; Chi troops came to rescue and lost.

sentences.zh: 朝廷憂之，遂以居安爲帥。

translations.literal: The court worried; then Juan was made commander.
translations.idiomatic: The court worried; then Juan was made commander.

sentences.zh: 居安以書曉都統制許俊曰：「賊勝則民皆爲賊，官軍勝則賊皆爲民，勢之翕張，決於此舉。

translations.literal: Juan by letter instructed the overall commander Xu Jun: "If bandits win then the people all become bandits; if government troops win then bandits all become people—the swelling and shrinking of momentum is decided in this one move.
translations.idiomatic: Juan by letter instructed the overall commander Xu Jun: "If bandits win then the people all become bandits; if government troops win then bandits all become people—the swelling and shrinking of momentum is decided in this one move.

sentences.zh: 將軍素以勇名，挫於山賊可乎？」

translations.literal: The general is always famed for courage—can you be frustrated by mountain bandits?"
translations.idiomatic: The general is always famed for courage—can you be frustrated by mountain bandits?"

sentences.zh: 俊得書皇恐，不敢以他帥事居安，居安督戰于黃山，勝之，賊始懼，走韶州，爲摧鋒軍所敗，勢日蹙。

translations.literal: Jun received the letter in alarm and did not dare treat Juan as another commander; Juan supervised battle at Huangshan and won; the bandits first feared and fled to Shaozhou, were defeated by the vanguard army, and momentum daily tightened.
translations.idiomatic: Jun received the letter in alarm and did not dare treat Juan as another commander; Juan supervised battle at Huangshan and won; the bandits first feared and fled to Shaozhou, were defeated by the vanguard army, and momentum daily tightened.

sentences.zh: 吉守前以戰不利，用招降之策，遣吏持受降圖來，書賊銜「江湖兩路大都統。」

translations.literal: The Ji prefect earlier because battle was unfavorable used the policy of recruiting surrender; he sent clerks with a surrender-reception chart; the bandits' title read "Great Commander-in-Chief of the Two Routes of Rivers and Lakes."
translations.idiomatic: The Ji prefect earlier because battle was unfavorable used the policy of recruiting surrender; he sent clerks with a surrender-reception chart; the bandits' title read "Great Commander-in-Chief of the Two Routes of Rivers and Lakes."

sentences.zh: 居安笑曰：「賊玩侮如此，猶爲國有人乎？」

translations.literal: Juan laughed and said: "The bandits play and insult thus—are there still people for the state?"
translations.idiomatic: Juan laughed and said: "The bandits play and insult thus—are there still people for the state?"

sentences.zh: 白諸朝，吉守以祠去。

translations.literal: He reported to the court; the Ji prefect was given a sinecure and left.
translations.idiomatic: He reported to the court; the Ji prefect was given a sinecure and left.

sentences.zh: 遂命居安節制江、池大軍，駐廬陵督捕，領郡事。

translations.literal: Then Juan was ordered to command the great armies of Jiang and Chi, garrison Luling to supervise pursuit, and hold prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Then Juan was ordered to command the great armies of Jiang and Chi, garrison Luling to supervise pursuit, and hold prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 召土豪問便宜，皆言賊恃險陟降如猿猱，若鈔吾糧，吾事危矣。

translations.literal: He summoned local magnates to ask what was expedient; all said the bandits relied on terrain and climbed and descended like gibbons; if they raided our grain our affair would be perilous.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned local magnates to ask what was expedient; all said the bandits relied on terrain and climbed and descended like gibbons; if they raided our grain our affair would be perilous.

sentences.zh: 居安曰：「吾自有以破賊。」

translations.literal: Juan said: "I naturally have means to break the bandits."
translations.idiomatic: Juan said: "I naturally have means to break the bandits."

sentences.zh: 會元勵執練木橋賊首李才全至，居安厚待才全而賞元勵，衆皆感。

translations.literal: It happened that Yuanli captured the Lianmu Bridge bandit chief Li Caiquan; Juan treated Caiquan generously and rewarded Yuanli; all were moved.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Yuanli captured the Lianmu Bridge bandit chief Li Caiquan; Juan treated Caiquan generously and rewarded Yuanli; all were moved.

sentences.zh: 羅世傳果疑元勵之貳已，遂交惡。

translations.literal: Luo Shichuan indeed suspected Yuanli's disloyalty to himself and thus became mutually hostile.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Shichuan indeed suspected Yuanli's disloyalty to himself and thus became mutually hostile.

sentences.zh: 元勵率衆攻世傳，居安語俊曰：「兩虎鬥於穴，吾可成卞莊子之功。」

translations.literal: Yuanli led his crowd to attack Shichuan; Juan told Jun: "Two tigers fight in the cave—we can accomplish Bian Zhuangzi's achievement."
translations.idiomatic: Yuanli led his crowd to attack Shichuan; Juan told Jun: "Two tigers fight in the cave—we can accomplish Bian Zhuangzi's achievement."

sentences.zh: 世傳嗾練木橋賊黨襲元勵，俘其孥，禽元勵以獻。

translations.literal: Shichuan incited Lianmu Bridge bandit factions to attack Yuanli, captured his women and children, and seized Yuanli to present.
translations.idiomatic: Shichuan incited Lianmu Bridge bandit factions to attack Yuanli, captured his women and children, and seized Yuanli to present.

sentences.zh: 時青草峒賊亦就禽，並磔于吉之南門。

translations.literal: At the time the Qingcao Cave bandits were also captured; all were dismembered at Ji's south gate.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Qingcao Cave bandits were also captured; all were dismembered at Ji's south gate.

sentences.zh: 元勵既誅，世傳以功負恃益驕蹇，名效順而實自保。

translations.literal: Yuanli already executed, Shichuan relied on merit and became ever more arrogant and difficult; in name he submitted but in fact he protected himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanli already executed, Shichuan relied on merit and became ever more arrogant and difficult; in name he submitted but in fact he protected himself.

sentences.zh: 俊請班師，居安不許，俾因賊堡壁固守。

translations.literal: Jun requested to withdraw troops; Juan did not permit it and made them because of the bandits' fortresses hold fast.
translations.idiomatic: Jun requested to withdraw troops; Juan did not permit it and made them because of the bandits' fortresses hold fast.

sentences.zh: 居亡何，世傳果與兄世祿俱叛。

translations.literal: Before long Shichuan indeed rebelled together with his elder brother Shilu.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Shichuan indeed rebelled together with his elder brother Shilu.

sentences.zh: 居安奏乞朝廷毋憂，今落其角距，可一戰禽也。

translations.literal: Juan memorialized begging the court not to worry—now their horns and spurs have fallen and in one battle they can be captured.
translations.idiomatic: Juan memorialized begging the court not to worry—now their horns and spurs have fallen and in one battle they can be captured.

sentences.zh: 乃密爲方略，遣官民兵合圍之，世傳自經死，斬其首以徇，群盜次第平。

translations.literal: Then he secretly made plans, sent official and militia troops to combine and surround them; Shichuan hanged himself; his head was cut off to display; the host of bandits were pacified in order.
translations.idiomatic: Then he secretly made plans, sent official and militia troops to combine and surround them; Shichuan hanged himself; his head was cut off to display; the host of bandits were pacified in order.

sentences.zh: 居安之在軍中也，賞厚罰明，將吏盡力，始終用以賊擊賊之策，故兵民無傷者。

translations.literal: While Juan was in the army rewards were thick and punishments clear; generals and clerks exerted their strength; from beginning to end he always used the policy of using bandits to strike bandits—therefore soldiers and people were without harm.
translations.idiomatic: While Juan was in the army rewards were thick and punishments clear; generals and clerks exerted their strength; from beginning to end he always used the policy of using bandits to strike bandits—therefore soldiers and people were without harm.

sentences.zh: 江西人祠而祝之，刻石紀功。

translations.literal: The people of Jiangxi enshrined and prayed to him and carved stone to record merit.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jiangxi enshrined and prayed to him and carved stone to record merit.

sentences.zh: 徙鎮襄陽，以言者罷，閒居十有一年。

translations.literal: He was transferred to command Xiangyang; because of speakers he was dismissed and lived in retirement eleven years.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to command Xiangyang; because of speakers he was dismissed and lived in retirement eleven years.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十五年與魏了翁同召，遷工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Jiading he was summoned together with Wei Liaoweng and transferred to vice minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Jiading he was summoned together with Wei Liaoweng and transferred to vice minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 時方受寶，中朝皆動色相賀。

translations.literal: At the time they were just receiving the treasure; within the court all changed countenance to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: At the time they were just receiving the treasure; within the court all changed countenance to congratulate.

sentences.zh: 入對，首言：「人主畏無難而不畏多難，輿地寶玉之歸，盍思當時之所以失。」

translations.literal: On audience he first spoke: "The ruler fears having no difficulty and does not fear many difficulties; the return of territory and jade treasure—why not think of how it was lost at the time?
translations.idiomatic: On audience he first spoke: "The ruler fears having no difficulty and does not fear many difficulties; the return of territory and jade treasure—why not think of how it was lost at the time?

sentences.zh: 言極切至。

translations.literal: His speech was extremely cutting.
translations.idiomatic: His speech was extremely cutting.

sentences.zh: 甫兩月，以集英殿修撰提舉玉隆宮。

translations.literal: Only two months later, as compiler at the Hall for Assembling Excellence he was made intendant of the Yulong Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Only two months later, as compiler at the Hall for Assembling Excellence he was made intendant of the Yulong Palace.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以寶謨閣待制知溫州，郡政大舉。

translations.literal: Before long, as awaiting-command academician of the Baomo Pavilion he was made prefect of Wenzhou; prefectural government was greatly raised.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, as awaiting-command academician of the Baomo Pavilion he was made prefect of Wenzhou; prefectural government was greatly raised.

sentences.zh: 理宗即位，以敷文閣待制知福州，升龍圖閣直學士，轉大中大夫，提舉崇福宮。

translations.literal: When Emperor Lizong took the throne, as awaiting-command academician of the Fuwen Pavilion he was made prefect of Fuzhou, advanced to direct academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall, transferred to grandee for proper service, and made intendant of the Chongfu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Lizong took the throne, as awaiting-command academician of the Fuwen Pavilion he was made prefect of Fuzhou, advanced to direct academician of the Dragon Diagram Hall, transferred to grandee for proper service, and made intendant of the Chongfu Palace.

sentences.zh: 將行，鹽寇起甯化，居安以書諭汀守曰：「土瘠民貧，業於鹽可盡禁耶？

translations.literal: About to depart, salt bandits rose at Ninghua; Juan by letter instructed the Ting prefect: "The soil is poor and the people poor—can the salt trade be entirely forbidden?
translations.idiomatic: About to depart, salt bandits rose at Ninghua; Juan by letter instructed the Ting prefect: "The soil is poor and the people poor—can the salt trade be entirely forbidden?

sentences.zh: 且彼執三首惡以自贖，宜治此三人，他可勿治。」

translations.literal: Moreover they hold the three chief villains to ransom themselves—it is fitting to punish these three men; the others need not be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover they hold the three chief villains to ransom themselves—it is fitting to punish these three men; the others need not be punished.

sentences.zh: 部使者遣左翼軍將鄧起提兵往，起貪夜冒險與寇角以死，軍潰，民相驚逃去。

translations.literal: The circuit commissioner sent the Left Wing Army general Deng Qi to lead troops; Qi greedily took night risk and fought the bandits to the death; the army collapsed and the people mutually alarmed and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit commissioner sent the Left Wing Army general Deng Qi to lead troops; Qi greedily took night risk and fought the bandits to the death; the army collapsed and the people mutually alarmed and fled.

sentences.zh: 事聞，命居安專任招捕。

translations.literal: When the affair was reported, Juan was ordered solely to undertake recruitment and pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was reported, Juan was ordered solely to undertake recruitment and pursuit.

sentences.zh: 居安既留，募軍校劉華、丘銳者授以計畫，至汀而賊已至郡矣，州人大懼。

translations.literal: Juan having stayed, recruited military school officers Liu Hua and Qiu Rui and gave them plans; arriving at Ting the bandits had already reached the prefecture; the prefectural people were greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Juan having stayed, recruited military school officers Liu Hua and Qiu Rui and gave them plans; arriving at Ting the bandits had already reached the prefecture; the prefectural people were greatly afraid.

sentences.zh: 賊知帥有撫納意，即引退。

translations.literal: The bandits knew the commander had intent to soothe and accept and immediately withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits knew the commander had intent to soothe and accept and immediately withdrew.

sentences.zh: 華、銳出入賊中，指期約降。

translations.literal: Hua and Rui went in and out among the bandits and fixed a date for surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Hua and Rui went in and out among the bandits and fixed a date for surrender.

sentences.zh: 有以右班攝汀守者，倔強好大言，以知兵自任，欲出不意爲己功。

translations.literal: There was one who by right guard substituted as Ting prefect—stubborn and fond of big words, taking knowledge of military affairs upon himself, wishing to achieve merit by unexpected means.
translations.idiomatic: There was one who by right guard substituted as Ting prefect—stubborn and fond of big words, taking knowledge of military affairs upon himself, wishing to achieve merit by unexpected means.

sentences.zh: 賊知其謀，敗降約，而建、劍諸郡並江西嘯聚蜂起矣。

translations.literal: The bandits knew his plot; the agreement to surrender was broken; and Jian, Jian, and all circuits of Jiangxi rose in swarms like bees.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits knew his plot; the agreement to surrender was broken; and Jian, Jian, and all circuits of Jiangxi rose in swarms like bees.

sentences.zh: 居安議不合，歎曰：「吾可復求焦頭爛額之功耶？」

translations.literal: Juan's plan did not agree; he sighed and said: "Can I again seek the achievement of scorched head and rotting forehead?"
translations.idiomatic: Juan's plan did not agree; he sighed and said: "Can I again seek the achievement of scorched head and rotting forehead?"

sentences.zh: 即拜疏歸。

translations.literal: He immediately submitted a memorial and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately submitted a memorial and returned.

sentences.zh: 居安以書生，于兵事不學而能，必誅峒寇而降汀寇，皆非苟然者。

translations.literal: Juan was a literatus; in military affairs he did not study yet could do it; certainly executing cave bandits and subduing Ting bandits were none of them casual.
translations.idiomatic: Juan was a literatus; in military affairs he did not study yet could do it; certainly executing cave bandits and subduing Ting bandits were none of them casual.

sentences.zh: 卒，累贈少保。

translations.literal: He died and was cumulatively posthumously made Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was cumulatively posthumously made Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 居安宅心公明，待物不貳。

translations.literal: Juan's heart was public and bright; in treating things he was not double.
translations.idiomatic: Juan's heart was public and bright; in treating things he was not double.

sentences.zh: 有《方巖集》行世。

translations.literal: He had the Fangyan Collection circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He left the Fangyan Collection circulating in his time.

sentences.zh: 論曰：李宗勉在庶僚，論事平直，及入相，負公清之稱。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Li Zongmian among subordinate officials discussed affairs in a plain and direct way; on entering the council he bore the reputation of public integrity.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Li Zongmian among subordinate officials discussed affairs in a plain and direct way; on entering the council he bore the reputation of public integrity.

sentences.zh: 袁甫學有本原，善達其用，持節所過，其民至今思之。

translations.literal: Yuan Fu's learning had root and source; he was good at extending its use; wherever he held credentials the people to this day think of him.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Fu's learning had root and source; he was good at extending its use; wherever he held credentials the people to this day think of him.

sentences.zh: 劉黻分別邪正，侃侃敢言，亦難能者。

translations.literal: Liu Fu distinguished evil and upright and spoke frankly and boldly—he also is hard to achieve.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fu distinguished evil and upright and spoke frankly and boldly—he also is hard to achieve.

sentences.zh: 王居安掃除群邪，以匡王國，其志壯哉！

translations.literal: Wang Juan swept away the host of evil to rectify the royal state—his ambition was lofty!
translations.idiomatic: Wang Juan swept away the host of evil to rectify the royal state—his ambition was lofty!
